description: This file defines the Zend_Translate_Adapter_Qt class, a PHP class implementing a translation adapter for Qt translation files within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for loading and parsing XML-based translation data, and manages internal state for translation content.

classes.name: Zend_Translate_Adapter_Qt
classes.description: A PHP class that extends Zend_Translate_Adapter to provide support for Qt translation files, including XML parsing and translation data management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with data, locale, and options.

methods.name: _loadTranslationData
methods.description: Loads and parses a Qt translation XML file, populating the translation array.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element during parsing, setting internal state.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, updating translation mappings.

methods.name: _contentElement
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements, accumulating translation content.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the adapter, 'Qt'.
